CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center

PATIENT: [redacted name]
DATE OF BIRTH: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
SPECIMEN TYPE: Fetal tissue
DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Analysis of fetal tissue sample

TEST PERFORMED
Oligonucleotide Array Comparative Genomic Hybridization (Array CGH)

RESULT SUMMARY
Array CGH on uncultured fetal tissue showed no imbalance of known fully penetrant pathogenicity. Results consistent with normal female chromosome complement.

TECHNICAL DETAILS
Methodology: Oligonucleotide array analysis performed using GeneScan design 085X platform containing approximately 60,000 probes distributed across the genome with a median resolution of 120kb. DNA was extracted from uncultured fetal tissue and processed according to manufacturer's protocols. Analysis was performed using GenomeView software. All genomic positions are reported based on GRCh37/hg19 reference sequence.

Supplementary Testing: QF-PCR analysis showed no evidence of triploidy.

RESULTS
Chromosomes 1-22: No copy number imbalances detected
Chromosome X: Two copies detected (consistent with female)
Chromosome Y: Not detected

Array Formula: arr(1-22,X)x2

INTERPRETATION
No clinically significant copy number abnormalities were detected. The results are consistent with a normal female chromosomal profile.

LIMITATIONS
This test cannot detect balanced chromosomal rearrangements, regions of homozygosity that do not result in copy number change, or low-level mosaicism (<20%). Point mutations and small insertions/deletions below the resolution of the array will not be detected. Interpretation is based on current knowledge of genomic variants and may change as new information becomes available.

RECOMMENDATIONS
No further chromosome analysis is needed for this sample.

Reported by: [redacted name], Ph.D.
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], M.D., Ph.D.
